scaleAudit.note: Steps are not a constant ratio — the ramp grows by convenience (a 4px/8px grid), not by a modular scale. Weight, not size, does most of the hierarchy work: 300 for display, 700 for card titles, 600 for links.

motifs.photography: Editorial, warmly lit, people-centred, frequently staged around the NAB star (a star-shaped hole punched through a wall). Studio lighting rigs are deliberately left in frame, so the photography reads as knowingly constructed rather than documentary.

buttonConversion.note: Green is reserved for the single highest-intent action on a page ('Get started', 'Talk to an expert'); red primary carries everything else.

buttonDark.note: Used where the surface behind is NAB red (the /business masthead), since a red button would vanish.

buttonTertiary.note: The most common 'button' on the site is really an underlined red text link with a trailing chevron.

voice.heroHeadline: Ready for a new everyday account?
voice.heroSubcopy: With our NAB Classic Banking account you'll get flexible access to your money and be able to track your spending.
voice.heroRotationEvidence: A second live render of / and /personal returned the slide 'Looking for a Personal Loan?' from identical markup — the masthead is selected server-side per request. Alternate slide observed: 'Looking for a Personal Loan?'.
voice.heroImageNote: 1440x480 rendered. Two women climbing through a star-shaped hole punched in a pink wall, studio lighting rigs visible in frame.
voice.firstParagraph: With our NAB Classic Banking account you'll get flexible access to your money and be able to track your spending.
ctaSamples: Explore ways to bank with us
headlineSamples: Ready for a new everyday account?
We're here to help with whatever life looks like
Get the most out of business banking
Earn up to 250,000 NAB Rewards Bonus Points
What do you need help with?
Support services and other helpful information
voice.register: Second person, present tense, plainly reassuring. Questions are used as headings to name the reader's situation ('Ready for a new everyday account?', 'Thinking about refinancing?', 'What do you need help with?') rather than to assert product superiority. Sentences are short and unhedged in the promise, then immediately qualified by a separate compliance sentence ('Other fees and charges apply. Consider the T&Cs, TMD and if right for you.'). Effort is quantified wherever possible — 'Open in less than 5 minutes', 'Schedule your chat in 2 minutes.' The brand line is 'more than money'.
voice.antiReferences: No exclamation marks, no superlatives about the bank itself except where externally awarded and cited (Finder Awards 2026, Coalition Greenwich study), no jargon in headings, no urgency devices beyond dated promotional terms.

voiceTable.note: 41% of section headings are questions addressed to the reader — the single strongest voice signal on the site.

crossPromo.description: Every captured page carries the same four mega-menu promo panels (deposits campaign, pay-by-card, Jocelyn Bloor masthead, international money transfer), so those four 1440x480 rasters appear in the media inventory of all 5 pages regardless of topic.
crossPromo.note: This is navigation chrome, not page content — downstream phases must not treat these images as page-level hero candidates.
